changes: Tail, older-page, newer-page and around-message loads capture account, composer generation and local device before network work. Abandoned responses are rejected before decrypting; guards also reach asynchronous historical decryption and prevent stale publication.

Tail loads retain their abort controller throughout decryption. Older/newer pages reject a replaced history window instead of merging into a different window. Newer-page locks use request identities; invalidation releases old locks without allowing their eventual finally block to release a replacement request.
Fetch-cache invalidation clears newer-page requests and the message loading indicator as well as existing history/around-request state.
verification: Targeted dmStore suite passed: 39 tests. Added account/generation/device response rejection, invalidation while decryption is pending, replaced older-page window and overlapping invalidated/replacement newer-page request regressions.
TypeScript tsc -b, targeted ESLint and targeted git diff --check passed.
Full client suite passed: 230 files / 2261 tests in 46.61s. Vite production build passed in 696ms with existing chunk/dynamic-import warnings.
remaining: Per-message WS edit/delete versus historical response ordering and monotonic cache-write arbitration remain open. A versioned cache read cannot by itself prevent an older asynchronous write from replacing a newer cache entry.

Window replacement during pagination conservatively discards that page; retry usability and live multi-client behavior still need browser acceptance. Network error handling and cross-tab session/cache atomicity need further verification.
This is not full P1 or P4 acceptance. Real device/two-client tests, remaining P0-P11 work, packaging and release remain open. No GitHub or production mutation performed.
